detection.title: Remote script piped into an interpreter
detection.remedy: Download the script, review it and run it from disk; add the host or URL to the installer allowlist if it is an approved installer.

detection.title: Private key or stored credential read by an agent tool
detection.remedy: Confirm the user asked for the contents; rotate the credential if the session also sent data out.

detection.title: Local file or stream uploaded to an unapproved host
detection.remedy: Check the destination and the file; add the host to approved_upload_hosts if it is the organisation's.

check.title: Installed agent without spoor's hooks
check.subject: ~/.claude
check.remedy: Run spoor hooks install --scope managed (or user) for this agent.

check.title: Agent session logs not where spoor reads them
check.subject: ~/.claude
check.remedy: No action on its own; check that relocated directories are passed to the daemon.

check.title: Managed policy missing or hooks not locked to managed
check.subject: ~/.claude
check.remedy: Deploy managed settings with allowManagedHooksOnly through Fleet.

check.title: MCP server fetched and run unpinned at every launch
check.subject: ~/.claude.json
check.remedy: Pin an exact version or image digest.
